    *   Fixed bug [#63185](https://bugs.php.net/63185) (nextRowset() ignores MySQL errors with native prepared statements).
    *   Fixed bug [#78152](https://bugs.php.net/78152) (PDO::exec() - Bad error handling with multiple commands).
    *   Fixed bug [#66878](https://bugs.php.net/66878) (Multiple rowsets not returned unless PDO statement object is unset()).
    *   Fixed bug [#70066](https://bugs.php.net/70066) (Unexpected "Cannot execute queries while other unbuffered queries").
    *   Fixed bug [#71145](https://bugs.php.net/71145) (Multiple statements in init command triggers unbuffered query error).
    *   Fixed bug [#76815](https://bugs.php.net/76815) (PDOStatement cannot be GCed/closeCursor-ed when a PROCEDURE resultset SIGNAL).
    *   Fixed bug [#79872](https://bugs.php.net/79872) (Can't execute query with pending result sets).
    *   Fixed bug [#79131](https://bugs.php.net/79131) (PDO does not throw an exception when parameter values are missing).
    *   Fixed bug [#72368](https://bugs.php.net/72368) (PdoStatement->execute() fails but does not throw an exception).
    *   Fixed bug [#62889](https://bugs.php.net/62889) (LOAD DATA INFILE broken).
    *   Fixed bug [#67004](https://bugs.php.net/67004) (Executing PDOStatement::fetch() more than once prevents releasing resultset).
    *   Fixed bug [#79132](https://bugs.php.net/79132) (PDO re-uses parameter values from earlier calls to execute()).
*   Phar:
    *   Fixed bug [#73809](https://bugs.php.net/73809) (Phar Zip parse crash - mmap fail).
    *   Fixed bug [#75102](https://bugs.php.net/75102) (\`PharData\` says invalid checksum for valid tar).

*   Phpdbg:

*   SPL:

*   Standard:

*   Tidy:

*   Tokenizer:

*   XML:

*   Zlib:

### Version 8.0.0

**26 Nov 2020**

*   BZ2:

    *   Fixed bug [#78236](https://bugs.php.net/78236) (convert error on receiving variables when duplicate \[).

    *   Fixed bug [#79108](https://bugs.php.net/79108) (Referencing argument in a function makes it a reference in the stack trace).

    *   Fixed bug [#79462](https://bugs.php.net/79462) (method\_exists and property\_exists incoherent behavior).
    *   Fixed bug [#79467](https://bugs.php.net/79467) (data:// wrappers are writable).
    *   Fixed bug [#79521](https://bugs.php.net/79521) (Check \_\_set\_state structure).
    *   Fixed bug [#79790](https://bugs.php.net/79790) ("Illegal offset type" exception during AST evaluation not handled properly).
    *   Fixed bug [#79791](https://bugs.php.net/79791) (Assertion failure when unsetting variable during binary op).
    *   Fixed bug [#79828](https://bugs.php.net/79828) (Segfault when trying to access non-existing variable).
    *   Fixed bug [#79841](https://bugs.php.net/79841) (Syntax error in configure / unescaped "\[\]" in php.m4).
    *   Fixed bug [#79852](https://bugs.php.net/79852) (count(DOMNodeList) doesn't match count(IteratorIterator(DOMNodeList))).
    *   Fixed bug [#79867](https://bugs.php.net/79867) (Promoted untyped properties should get null default value).
    *   Fixed bug [#79897](https://bugs.php.net/79897) (Promoted constructor params with attribs cause crash).
    *   Fixed bug [#79927](https://bugs.php.net/79927) (Generator doesn't throw exception after multiple yield from iterable).
    *   Fixed bug [#79946](https://bugs.php.net/79946) (Build fails due to undeclared UINT32\_C).
    *   Fixed bug [#79948](https://bugs.php.net/79948) (Exit in auto-prepended file does not abort PHP execution).
    *   Fixed bug [#80045](https://bugs.php.net/80045) (memleak after two set\_exception\_handler calls with \_\_call).
    *   Fixed bug [#80096](https://bugs.php.net/80096) (Segmentation fault with named arguments in nested call).
    *   Fixed bug [#80109](https://bugs.php.net/80109) (Cannot skip arguments when extended debug is enabled).
    *   Fixed bug [#80225](https://bugs.php.net/80225) (broken namespace usage in eval code).
    *   Fixed bug [#80258](https://bugs.php.net/80258) (Windows Deduplication Enabled, randon permission errors).
    *   Fixed bug [#80280](https://bugs.php.net/80280) (ADD\_EXTENSION\_DEP() fails for ext/standard and ext/date).
    *   Fixed bug [#80334](https://bugs.php.net/80334) (assert() vs named parameters - confusing error).
    *   Fixed bug [#80055](https://bugs.php.net/80055) (Abstract trait methods returning "self" cannot be fulfilled by traits).
    *   Fixed faulty generator cleanup with yield from.
    *   Implement #\[Attr\] Attribute syntax as per final vote in RFC https://wiki.php.net/rfc/shorter\_attribute\_syntax\_change
    *   Implemented FR [#47074](https://bugs.php.net/47074) (phpinfo() reports "On" as 1 for the some extensions).

*   Curl:
    *   Bumped required libcurl version to 7.29.0.
    *   Fixed bug [#80121](https://bugs.php.net/80121) (Null pointer deref if CurlHandle directly instantiated).
*   DOM:
    *   Add property DOMXPath::$registerNodeNamespaces and constructor argument that allow global flag to configure query() or evaluate() calls.
    *   Fixed bug [#79968](https://bugs.php.net/79968) (DOMChildNode API crash on unattached nodes).
    *   Fixed bug [#80268](https://bugs.php.net/80268) (loadHTML() truncates at NUL bytes).
*   Date:

    *   Fixed bug [#80057](https://bugs.php.net/80057) (DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat() does not populate time).
    *   Implemented FR [#79903](https://bugs.php.net/79903) (datetime: new format "p", same as "P" but returning "Z" for UTC).

    *   Add "flags" options to ZipArchive::addGlob and addPattern methods keeping previous behavior having FL\_OVERWRITE by default.
    *   Add ZipArchive::EM\_UNKNOWN and ZipArchive::EM\_TRAD\_PKWARE constants.
    *   Add ZipArchive::isCompressionMethodSupported() and ZipArchive::isEncryptionMethodSupported() method (libzip 1.7.0).
    *   Add ZipArchive::replaceFile() method.
    *   Add ZipArchive::setCancelCallback method (since libzip 1.6.0).
    *   Add ZipArchive::setMtimeName and ZipArchive::setMtimeIndex methods.
    *   Add ZipArchive::setProgressCallback method (since libzip 1.3.0).
    *   Add lastId property to ZipArchive.
    *   Add optional "flags" parameter to ZipArchive::addEmptyDir, addFile and addFromString methods.
    *   Fixed bug [#50678](https://bugs.php.net/50678) (files extracted by ZipArchive class lost their original modified time).
    *   Fixed bug [#72374](https://bugs.php.net/72374) (remove\_path strips first char of filename).
    *   Implemented FR [#77960](https://bugs.php.net/77960) (add compression / encryption options for ZipArchive::addGlob and ZipArchive::addPattern).
    *   ZipArchive::status and ZipArchive::statusSys properties and ZipArchive::getStatusString() method stay valid after the archive is closed.
*   Zlib:
    *   Fixed bug [#71417](https://bugs.php.net/71417) (fread() does not report zlib.inflate errors).
    *   Fixed bug [#78792](https://bugs.php.net/78792) (zlib.output\_compression disabled by Content-Type: image/).
